manifest: TouchlineSimulator Visual V1 — PixelLab asset freeze
retrieval_method: non-generative HTTP GET of existing PixelLab assets (frame CDN + authenticated /mcp tileset endpoints); zero PixelLab generations spent
notes: Original downloads live under originals/ and must never be resampled, recolored, antialiased, or otherwise altered.
Any runtime-packed representation must be derived into a separate directory, leaving originals/ byte-identical to HASHES.sha256.
Animated Idle intentionally does not exist for the MVP; static 8-direction rotations are the accepted Idle.
The experimental east-only Dribble/Carry animation (group 5fc20f4b-b01e-4443-88ed-7a5b5f187681) was intentionally NOT imported.

Animation frame canvases are larger than the 128x128 character base (motion padding, source-faithful): 140x140 for most directions, 144x144 for north-east/north-west in the v3 template groups. Frames are assumed pivot-centred per PixelLab convention; this must be validated visually in the renderer sandbox.
Signed/transient URLs and credentials are deliberately excluded; assets are addressed by PixelLab IDs only.

idle.source: static 8-direction rotations of character 31a11357-1d06-40c3-958e-5103d1fdd8cd (no animation group; rotations are part of the Idle state)

jog.acceptance: VERIFIED_ACCEPTED (user directive: template Jogging group is the base; custom South-East group fills SE)

EXPERIMENTAL/PRESERVED — competing E jog variant, superseded at runtime by template Jogging E per user directive
EXPERIMENTAL/PRESERVED — competing W jog variant, superseded at runtime by template Jogging W per user directive

upper.description_short: professional pitch grass with mowing variation

grass_tileset.slicing_rule: Slice the sheet using each tile's bounding_box from tileset_metadata.json ONLY. Never derive positions from wang_N names or original_position (produces banding, per PixelLab metadata warning).
grass_tileset.scope_limitation: Surface texture/material ONLY. This tileset does NOT define pitch geometry, white markings, boundaries, penalty areas, goals, or simulator coordinates. Authoritative geometry comes from the engine.

goal_art.acceptance: EXPERIMENTAL/REJECTED for Visual V1 presentation (2026-08-27 review: front-facing, unsuitable for the sideline perspective camera). File preserved; NOT loaded by the sandbox — goals are procedural 3D geometry.
derivation: Original stored untouched. At sandbox load time a derived copy strips the baked grass mound with the deterministic chroma rule g>r+20 && g>b+20 (transparent).
Right-end goal is the same art mirrored horizontally at render time — no second generation.
Artwork is presentation only: authoritative goal geometry (7.32m mouth, 2.44m bar) stays procedural and unchanged by the art.

KNOWN LIMITATION flagged for review: the art is front-on (mouth toward viewer) while the true mouths open east/west; integrated as a stylized billboard scaled to player metric height. A side-profile goal would need a future authorized generation.

goal_art_rejected_candidate.acceptance: EXPERIMENTAL/REJECTED (2026-08-27 — corrective side-profile attempt still came out front-on and paler; attempt 1 kept as working art)

derivation: Rendered as a perspective-correct vertical wall on the plane z = -8 m (far apron edge), outside the playing surface.
Mirror-tiled along world x (alternate copies flipped) so left/right panning exposes no seams or gaps; one strip covers the whole visible environment.
Scenery only: never occludes the pitch, players, or ball; drawn before the ground pass.

goal_art_v3_oblique.acceptance: PENDING_VISUAL_REVIEW (generated 2026-08-27 under explicit single-generation authorization; reference-image-guided)
goal_art_v3_oblique.tool: create_image_pixflux (img2img: init_image = isolated goal crop from the user's EA-FC-style reference screenshot, strength 200)

reference_input.derivation: Goal region cropped from the supplied reference screenshot, background chroma-isolated (keep low-saturation light pixels), player fragment erased. The generation call used a 64x68 6-colour compressed copy of this (inline transport limits).

notes: Correct high three-quarter oblique orientation achieved (matches reference spatial read): foreshortened mouth, dominant side net, roof + rear depth.

Known issues for review: greenish tint bled from the reference grass into the net; 64x68 output (init size adopted) limits cord detail; net reads as textured panels rather than crisp individual cords.
NOT integrated into the sandbox; the procedural Goal V3 remains the active presentation. Exactly one generation spent; no retry performed per instruction.

goal_art_v2_oblique.acceptance: PENDING_VISUAL_REVIEW (generated 2026-08-27 under explicit single-generation authorization; full-resolution reference transport via sanctioned REST route)
goal_art_v2_oblique.reference_preparation: Same 156x166 screenshot crop as V1, re-isolated with a tighter keep rule, every kept pixel neutralized to luminance grey (zero green-dominant pixels), player fragment erased, LANCZOS-upscaled x2 to 312x332. No quantization; geometry/orientation untouched.
notes: Accepted V1 oblique orientation preserved: foreshortened mouth, dominant side net, roof net, rear frame/net, rectangular box silhouette.
Net now resolves as individual cords with clear intersections; zero green contamination (verified per-pixel).

Raw API output has an opaque uniform grey background (the API's no_background removal only applies to canvases <= 200x200). The derived copy keys that grey (tolerance 14) making background AND net holes genuinely transparent, and erases two small stray artifacts right of the goal (x>=268). Original stored byte-untouched.
NOT integrated; procedural Goal V3 remains the active presentation. V1 (goal_art_v3_oblique record) preserved separately.

goal_art_v2_1_clean.acceptance: EXPERIMENTAL/REJECTED (2026-08-27 review: too sterile, loses PixelLab detailing; preserved as an experiment only — V2 is the visual master)
goal_art_v2_1_clean.derivation_method: Deterministic reconstruction (option A): V2's accepted frame geometry measured from the art (8 corner points), external rear pole and stray artifacts omitted by construction, all net panels rebuilt as homography-mapped regular grids (roof 20x8, mouth 20x12, back 14x9 cells) with perspective-correct cell compression and subtle attachment-zero sag; frame redrawn along the measured members in V2's palette. Generator stored alongside for exact reproducibility.
notes: Accepted V2 orientation/proportions preserved exactly (same measured corners).
Net topology is a true connected grid per panel — no broken cells, oversized holes, or texture noise; holes genuinely transparent.
Grid regularity lives in goal-space; the projective panel mapping produces the on-screen compression.
NOT integrated; procedural Goal V3 remains the active sandbox presentation.

goal_art_v2_2_surgical.acceptance: PENDING_VISUAL_REVIEW (derived 2026-08-27; 0 PixelLab generations; V2 is the accepted visual master)
goal_art_v2_2_surgical.derivation_method: Surgical pixel repair of goal_v2_derived_transparent.png. Pole removal: mask-based transparency restore of the two external diagonal pole arms (left of the rear upright above the ground rail; left of the near post below it) and the detached right stub (right of the sagging roof edge) — 2,819 px cleared, no replacement structure. Net tears: four abnormal openings in the mouth net filled by clone-stamping the intact cell row directly above (offsets (0,-13)/(0,-14)) — 427 px ADDED into transparent gaps only; no existing art pixel modified. Everything outside the logged masks verified pixel-identical (0 differing px).
notes: V2's artwork, silhouette, perspective, frame, net texture, sag and palette preserved exactly outside the repair masks.
NOT integrated; procedural Goal V3 remains the active sandbox presentation.

goal_art_v2_3_frozen_bake.acceptance: PENDING_VISUAL_REVIEW (derived 2026-08-28; 0 PixelLab generations; authorized one-time authoring bake)
goal_art_v2_3_frozen_bake.derivation_method: Deterministic panel-projective rectification of goal_v2_2_surgical.png into the frozen CAMERA_V1 projection: three measured art panels (mouth plane, roof net, near-side net; back net rides as baked through-view content) homography-mapped onto the authoritative frozen box-goal faces (7.32x2.44m mouth on the goal line, 2.0m depth, rear 2.44m). Shared panel edges map to identical destination lines (seam-free); outer-edge margins preserve the sag silhouette; cord-preserving footprint sampling (max-alpha, structure-biased nearest) - no blur, no halos, no broken cords. Generator: sandbox/visual/tools/bake_goal_v22_frozen.py.
goal_art_v2_3_frozen_bake.correspondence_errors_px: all 8 structural points 0.0000 (exact by homography construction); runtime residual = pixel snap <= 0.71px, pan-invariant
notes: Left goal = horizontal mirror about V x=640 (the frozen projection is x-symmetric) - no separate artwork.
Runtime treats it as an ordinary rigid 2D scene member; zero per-frame goal-specific correction.
If the projection is re-authored with different parameters the viewer falls back to the rigid V2.2 fit and flags it.

integrity.checks: PNG signature, per-chunk CRC32, full IDAT zlib decompression, IHDR dimensions, RGBA-8 (color type 6) on all 161 PNGs; per-direction frame counts complete; zero errors

engine_boundary: Visual integration consumes authoritative engine state read-only. No simulation file (decisions, movement physics, acceleration, stamina, possession, passing, reception, shooting, tackling, restarts, coordinates, timing) may be modified for visual reasons.
